title: Academic Writing
tagline: What research is, choosing a topic, finding literature, reading and notes, the literature review, structure and argument, citation and references, academic integrity, the language of scholarship, and the thesis and its defence
summary: A thesis in Chinese language or literature asks a question that has not yet been answered, places it among earlier work and answers it with evidence. This course covers choosing a topic, searching databases such as CNKI, reading and taking notes, writing a literature review, structuring the argument of a paper, citing according to the national standard, academic integrity, the language of scholarship, and writing and defending a graduation thesis.

chapters.title: What research is
chapters.summary: Questions, evidence and contribution in the study of language and literature, and the kinds of paper.

chapters.title: Choosing a topic
chapters.summary: From an interest to a question that can be answered, and narrowing a topic.

chapters.title: Finding literature
chapters.summary: Libraries, CNKI and other databases, databases of classical texts, and keeping track of sources.

chapters.title: Reading and notes
chapters.summary: Reading scholarship critically, and notes that keep quotation, paraphrase and one’s own ideas apart.

chapters.title: The literature review
chapters.summary: Synthesising earlier work by question rather than by author, and finding the gap.

chapters.title: Structure and argument
chapters.summary: Introduction, body and conclusion, primary texts as evidence, and close reading in an argument.

chapters.title: Citation and references
chapters.summary: Direct and indirect quotation, footnotes, and the national standard for references, GB/T 7714—2015.

chapters.title: Academic integrity
chapters.summary: Plagiarism, self-plagiarism and fabrication, similarity checking, and using AI tools within the rules.

chapters.title: The language of scholarship
chapters.summary: Precision, caution and economy in academic Chinese, and avoiding both jargon and grand empty phrases.

chapters.title: The thesis and its defence
chapters.summary: Planning and writing a graduation thesis, working with a supervisor, and the oral defence.
